content: {"like":["Prefers visually appealing, beautifully shot imagery and imaginative filmmaking techniques.","Enjoys well-acted, high-quality production with good lighting and sound design.","Likes short, engaging documentaries that explain complex concepts clearly.","Values multiple stories that keep action and horror fresh.","Enjoys uplifting content and tribute to musicians with high production quality."],"dislike":["Dislikes slow-moving stories that lose interest.","Avoids confusing, stream-of-consciousness experimental styles.","Prefers not to watch unfeeling, self-centered characters.","Dislikes movies that drag on and feel boring.","Avoids confusing plots with unsatisfying lack of explanation."]}
